ORDER ON BOIES, SCHILLER & FLEXNER LLP AND JANE DOE NO, 3's MOTIONS TO QUASH SUBPOENAS OR FOR PROTECTIVE ORDER

This Cause comes belore the Court on November 2, 2015 upon Boies, Schiller & Flexner L1P's Motion to Quash Subpoena Or For Pratective Order and Jane Doe No. 3°s Motion to Quash Subpoena Or For Protective Order.

Having reviewed the record and being otherwise fully advised, the Court hereby Orders:

1. Non-Party Law Firm Botes, Schiller & Flexner LLP's Motion to Quash Subpoena is

GRANTED. The subpoena to Boies, Schiller & Flexner LLP is quashed in its entirety.

to

Non-Party Jane Doe No. 3°s Motion to Quash Subpoena or For Protective Order is Denied in Part, Granted in part, as follows:
a. The Motion to Quash is Granted as to Requests Nos. 9,17, 18, 20, and 23. The Motion is denied as to the remaining Requests.
b. A Confidentiality Order shall be entered.
c. The deposition af Jane Doe No. 3 shall be limited to 4 hours without prejudice to request for additional time in the future.
